VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced an Architectural Draftsperson to join our clients' business Kubra Building Services Pty Ltd in Hawthorn East. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

The successful applicant will be responsible for assisting construction managers, architects and surveyors in the planning and organisation of construction projects. This is a hands-on drafting role suitable for a candidate with practical experience in preparing drawings, interpreting plans and coordinating project documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assist construction managers, architects and surveyors with planning, design coordination and project organisation.
- Interpret architectural plans, building regulations, standards and codes of practice.
- Prepare preliminary sketches, working drawings, specifications and detailed documentation for construction projects.
- Prepare, edit and revise plans, maps, charts and technical drawings using drafting software and relevant tools.
- Review drawings and documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance with project requirements.
- Coordinate works programs and assist with project documentation and scheduling requirements.
- Collaborate with architects, engineers, builders and other stakeholders to support project delivery.
- Maintain accurate records of drawings, revisions and project documentation.
- Ensure drafting work is completed in accordance with industry standards and workplace procedures.

Requirements:

- Relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design or a related field.
- Relevant experience as an Architectural Draftsperson, Building Designer or similar role.
- Ability to interpret architectural drawings, plans, regulations and construction documentation.
- Experience preparing and revising technical drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in drafting work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good understanding of construction processes and documentation requirements.

Salary: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per annum plus superannuation

Location: Level 1, Suite 3, 785 Toorak Road, Hawthorn East, VIC 3123

Hours: 38 hours per week

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
